info.title: PowerPortalsPro MCP server.
info.description: Model Context Protocol server for PowerPortalsPro. Gives AI coding agents the component API reference, working code samples and conventions for both the Blazor and React stacks, plus Dataverse metadata read live from the environment the project is already configured against. Reads are metadata-only; writes reach only the framework's own portal-role and website configuration tables, and deletions ask the user to confirm.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
With no arguments it speaks the Model Context Protocol over stdio; MCP clients launch
it that way. The commands below are for setting up the Dataverse connection.

commands.name: azure
commands.description: Bind this folder to an Azure subscription (azure --help for more)

options.name: --role
options.description:
`hosting` or `registrations`, for a workspace whose app
registrations are owned in a different tenant from where the
portal runs. Only needed when it cannot be inferred

options.name: --subscription
options.description: Use this subscription instead of asking

options.name: --tenant
options.description:
Authenticate against a specific Entra tenant. Needed when the
subscription belongs to a tenant you are a guest in

options.name: --location
options.description: Default region for resources, e.g. eastus

options.name: --username
options.description: Sign in as a specific account

options.name: --browser
options.description: Open a browser instead of showing a device code

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Act on another folder

commands.name: login
commands.description: Sign in and choose the subscription this folder deploys to

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Remove the subscription from this folder

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the bound subscription and whether it connects

commands.name: subscriptions
commands.description: List the subscriptions the signed-in account can see

options.name: --environment
options.description:
The environment to bind, e.g. https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com.
An environment already bound can be named by its name or position,
to sign in to it again.

options.name: --name
options.description: What to call it — dev, test, anything. Renames one already bound.

options.name: --make-primary
options.description:
Make it the primary: the environment tools use unless told otherwise.
Works for a new environment and for one already bound (--primary for short).

options.name: --pac-profile
options.description: Take the environment and account from a Power Platform CLI profile
